depends_on: OEIS A048940 (runs of 9s in pi, Kondo 2011)
category_override: disputed or partial; not a resolution
notes: Equivalent to pi containing 9^k for every k (T(n,k) is monotone and eventually constant). Known for k <= 14 from A048940 (first 14 nines at position 5758910552709); a(15) > 2.2e13. Implied by normality of pi. Outside Lean: the cited digit computations.

sources.cite: OEIS A048940, b-file (Weisstein, Resta, Kanada lab, Kondo, Petukhov)
sources.what: first runs of k nines in pi, k <= 14

prior_art.note: k <= 14 known; general case open (normality of pi).
